values.eml_summary: The same coherent full-DB forgery: internal audit OPEN_UNDETECTED, external anchor audit OPEN_DETECTED; prefix truncation: undetected without a trusted head, detected with one.

values.eml_interpretation: Detection, not prevention; and only under the stated key and head trust assumptions.
